name: AutoPost — publish to Facebook via Blotato

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes:
The only node you edit by hand.
blotatoAccountId / blotatoPageId — or clear the expressions on the Blotato publish node and pick both from its dropdowns instead.
facebookVideoMode — 'reel' or 'video'. Ignored for image posts.

nodes.name: Get new rows
nodes.notes: Only rows a human has moved to "Publish". n8n never writes this column.

nodes.name: Mark processing
nodes.notes: Claims the row in the automation column so an overlapping sweep can't publish it twice. The human `status` column is left alone.

nodes.name: Blotato upload media
nodes.notes: URL upload, not binary — the node's own note says binary is size-capped and to use a URL for Google Drive files (up to ~60 MB). Returns { url } on Blotato's CDN.

nodes.name: Blotato publish
nodes.notes: facebookMediaType resolves to '' for images, which the node treats as unset — mediaType only applies to video. Returns { postSubmissionId }.

nodes.name: Wait for publish
nodes.notes: Blotato publishes asynchronously — give it a moment before asking for the outcome.

assignments.name: result
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const ig = $('Build post payload').item.json.ignored || []; const extra = ig.length ? ' | ignored platforms: ' + ig.join(', ') : ''; const sub = $('Blotato publish').item.json.postSubmissionId || ''; if ($json.status === 'published') return 'facebook: posted — ' + ($json.publicUrl || 'no url returned') + extra; if ($json.status === 'failed') return 'facebook: FAILED — ' + ($json.errorMessage || 'no reason given') + extra; if ($json.error) return 'facebook: submitted — status check failed (' + String($json.error) + '), submission ' + sub + extra; return 'facebook: submitted — still in progress, submission ' + sub + extra; })() }}

nodes.name: Due yet?
nodes.notes: Compares the sheet's publish time to now. Rows that aren't due yet are left alone — NOT marked processing or failed — so the next sweep re-checks them.

nodes.name: Nothing to do
nodes.notes: Dead end on purpose — the row is either already handled or not due yet. Nothing is written, so the next sweep re-checks it.

nodes.name: Already handled?
nodes.notes: The `status` column stays on "Publish" after a post goes out, so this is what stops a published row being posted again on the next sweep. Anything in `post status` means hands off.
